tests.name: Contract, Host Remote Event, and TLS carrier suites

implemented: The pairing payload must own the client endpoint and pin, and CompanionRootView retains the newly paired LinkClient instead of rebuilding over a placeholder.
LinkClient consumes the generated recursive JSON, unary, and stream models; the parallel Swift envelope model was removed.
Unary responses enforce type and rpcId correlation, accept a successful omitted value as void, and reject invalid success/failure field combinations.
Remote Event processing takes clientId only from Host ready frames, reads waterfall fields from request, removes cancel frames, sends outcome, and clears the generation identity during reconnect.

Apple test source covers fresh transport ownership, generated fixture round trips, value/void/error responses, authoritative clientId refresh, nested requests, cancel, outcomes, and the no-ready refusal.
knownLimitations: Windows cannot compile or run Swift/Xcode. Test source and generated fixture freshness are present, but no native PASS is claimed.
The real Host pair-to-reconnect corpus remains absent; G1-E2E must execute it on a macOS runner before G1-APPLE can become PASS.

notExecuted.details: No Swift toolchain or Xcode is installed on the Windows execution host.
G1-E2E must provide the shipped Host process and shared acceptance corpus.
